site.anchor: As leis que deram ao Título VI a sua redação
provisions: CP arts. 213 to 249: every rule gated by the vigência of the law that gave its words their current form

source.quote: Art. 28. Esta lei entrará em vigor 30 (trinta) dias depois de sua publicação.

citations.cite: Lei nº 5.478/1968, art. 28 (DOU 26.7.1968, retificado em 14.8.1968 e republicado em 8.4.1974), as read by sweep-c, S-sweep-c-18
LINDB, art. 1º, §§ 3º e 4º, as quoted by sweep-c, S-sweep-c-18
Leis nº 15.280/2025 (8.12.2025) and 15.353/2026 (8.3.2026): in force on publication, sweep-c S-sweep-c-04

readings.description: Lei nº 5.478/1968's rectification of 14.8.1968, published inside its thirty-day vacatio, restarted the count (LINDB art. 1º, § 3º): in force 13.9.1968.

citations.cite: LINDB art. 1º, § 3º: 'Se, antes de entrar a lei em vigor, ocorrer nova publicação de seu texto, destinada a correção, o prazo ... começará a correr da nova publicação.'

readings.description: The thirty days ran from the original publication: in force 25.8.1968.
readings.foreclosure: Whether the rectification was a 'nova publicação destinada a correção' of the provisions in question is not established (S-sweep-c-18 did not compare the texts). The encoding refuses for a fact between 25.8 and 12.9.1968 rather than choose.

taken.rationale: Answer only where both readings agree: art. 244's penalty and parágrafo único answer from 13.9.1968 and refuse before. Every other law's date is settled by its own clause, read by sweep-c. Not established either way: whether the 1974 republication corrected art. 244 (LINDB art. 1º, § 4º would make a corrected provision date from 8.4.1974); no fact of 1968-1974 under art. 244 is live.

witnesses: cp-g4a-assistencia-familiar-testes.l4: `o devedor de pensão que a frustra, em` 13.9.1968 (answers) against 12.9.1968 (refuses)
notes: The rule the whole encoding follows: a rule answers for a fact from the vigência of the law that gave its words their current form. Before it: where the law ADDED a provision that replaced nothing in the Code, the provision is not law and the rule says so as an ordinary value; where it REPLACED earlier words, those govern and are not in the source, so the rule refuses by name.

The dates were first taken from the Senado record's DOU dates and the encoder's recollection of two vacatio clauses; sweep-c confirmed every one on 2026-09-29 (S-sweep-c-18) save Lei nº 5.478/1968, which it found to be 25.8.1968 or 13.9.1968 rather than the publication day.

site.anchor: crime de estupro (art. 213)

source.quote: Constranger alguém, mediante violência ou grave ameaça, a ter conjunção carnal ou a praticar ou permitir que com ele se pratique outro ato libidinoso

citations.cite: CP art. 215-A ("se o ato não constitui crime mais grave")

readings.description: One act within the words of several articles is ONE crime: art. 217-A (vulnerable victim) prevails by specialty over arts. 213 and 215; art. 213 over art. 215, the graver where violence or threat was used too; art. 215-A yields to any graver crime by its own words. Likewise art. 218 over art. 227 for a victim under fourteen, art. 218-B over art. 228 for one under eighteen or without discernment, and art. 235 over art. 237 where the known impediment is a marriage.

citations.cite: CP art. 215-A, preceito: 'se o ato não constitui crime mais grave'
CP art. 217-A: the vulnerable victim is the specialising element

readings.description: Each article applies on its own words, the court resolving the concurrence of offences.
readings.rejection_rationale: A single act against a single legal interest is not several crimes; the special provision's extra element (the victim's vulnerability or age) states the whole of the general one.

taken.rationale: Each exported predicate answers whether ITS crime is the one the facts make out; the literal 'os elementos ... estão reunidos' predicates remain for a reader who wants the words alone.

witnesses: cp-g4a-liberdade-sexual-testes.l4: `violência contra Carla` (art. 217-A, not art. 213, though the words of art. 213 are met)
cp-g4a-liberdade-sexual-testes.l4: `fraude e violência` (art. 213, not art. 215)
cp-g4a-lenocinio-testes.l4: `Carla induzida` (not art. 227)
notes: Where the agent's own violence makes the victim unable to resist, whether the case is art. 213 or art. 217-A, § 1º ('por qualquer outra causa') depends on how the fact supplier records the victim's condition; the encoding follows the condition as recorded. A Brazilian criminal lawyer should confirm the line.

site.anchor: o art. 226 alcança o crime
provisions: CP art. 226, caput, I, II and IV

source.quote: Art. 226. A pena é aumentada: I – de quarta parte, se o crime é cometido com o concurso de 2 (duas) ou mais pessoas; ... IV - de 1/3 (um terço) a 2/3 (dois terços), se o crime é praticado: Estupro coletivo a) mediante concurso de 2 (dois) ou mais agentes; Estupro corretivo b) para controlar o comportamento social ou sexual da vítima.

citations.cite: CP art. 226 (redação das Leis nº 11.106/2005 e 13.718/2018)
CP Título VI, Capítulo IV — Disposições gerais

readings.description: Art. 226 reaches the crimes of the chapters before its Disposições gerais (I, I-A, II); inciso IV, whose alíneas carry the rubrics 'Estupro coletivo' and 'Estupro corretivo', reaches estupro (arts. 213 and 217-A), and there IV, a displaces I, which states the same concurso with a smaller fraction.

citations.cite: CP art. 226, IV, rubricas 'Estupro coletivo', 'Estupro corretivo'

readings.description: Inciso IV reaches every crime of Capítulos I, I-A and II like the other incisos, and IV, a displaces I wherever both are met.

citations.cite: CP art. 226, IV: 'se o crime é praticado' (no crime named)

readings.foreclosure: Under the counting of F-g0-26 'duas ou mais pessoas' and 'dois ou mais agentes' coincide, so inciso I would never apply; the rubrics name estupro.

readings.description: I and IV, a apply together to the same concurso.

citations.cite: CP art. 226, I and IV, a

readings.rejection_rationale: One circumstance, two increases: bis in idem.

readings.description: Art. 226 reaches every crime of Título VI, Capítulos V and VI included.
readings.rejection_rationale: Capítulo V states its own relational qualified forms (arts. 227 § 1º, 228 § 1º, 230 § 1º), which art. 226, II would double; art. 234-A, which does reach the whole Título, says so ('neste Título') and art. 226 does not.

taken.rationale: The placement fixes the chapters; the rubrics fix inciso IV; the displacement of I by IV, a keeps both incisos operative. Not settled by any authority the sweep found; a court could read IV as reaching every crime of Capítulos I and II.

witnesses: cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4: `estupro a dois` (IV, not I) against `corrupção a dois` (I)
cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4: `fraude corretiva` (no IV for art. 215)
cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4: `mediação a dois` (Capítulo V not reached)

site.anchor: definido nos Capítulos I e II do Título VI (art. 225)

source.quote: Art. 225. Nos crimes definidos nos Capítulos I e II deste Título, procede-se mediante ação penal pública incondicionada.

readings.description: Capítulo I-A (art. 216-B), added after art. 225 was re-worded, is not named; art. 100 decides its ação penal (public and unconditioned, the law requiring no representation).
Capítulo I-A is part of the 'Capítulo I' sequence and art. 225 reaches it.

citations.cite: CP Título VI, Capítulo I-A (Lei nº 13.772/2018)

readings.foreclosure: Art. 225 names two chapters; Lei nº 13.772/2018 created a new one and did not amend art. 225. Both readings give a public, unconditioned prosecution.

taken.rationale: The words name Capítulos I and II. The answer does not change: art. 100's default is the same prosecution.

notes: cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4 asserts that `a ação penal do art. 225` of art. 216-B is NOTHING (art. 100 decides).

site.anchor: Art. 234-A — Aumento de pena

source.quote: Art. 234-A. Nos crimes previstos neste Título a pena é aumentada:

citations.cite: CP art. 232-A (Incluído pela Lei nº 13.445, de 2017), in Título VI, Capítulo V

readings.description: Art. 232-A (promoção de migração ilegal) is a crime 'previsto neste Título', and arts. 234-A and 234-B reach it.

Art. 232-A protects migration policy, not sexual dignity; Lei nº 13.445/2017 put it in Título VI only because the trafficking articles it replaced stood there, and the Título's general provisions do not reach it.

citations.cite: CP Título VI, rubric 'Dos crimes contra a dignidade sexual'

readings.foreclosure: The words 'neste Título' are unqualified, and art. 232-A's victim can be an older or disabled person (art. 234-A, IV).

taken.rationale: The words; nothing in the text excepts art. 232-A.

site.anchor: a relação é elementar do crime

source.quote: II - de metade, se o agente é ascendente, padrasto ou madrasta, tio, irmão, cônjuge, companheiro, tutor, curador, preceptor ou empregador da vítima ou por qualquer outro título tiver autoridade sobre ela;

citations.cite: CP art. 216-A: 'prevalecendo-se o agente da sua condição de superior hierárquico ou ascendência inerentes ao exercício de emprego, cargo ou função'

readings.description: In art. 216-A the employment authority the agent took advantage of is the crime's element and does not also bring in art. 226, II; a kinship the article does not need still does.
Art. 226, II applies to art. 216-A whenever the agent is the victim's employer or has authority over them.
readings.rejection_rationale: The element of the crime would increase its own penalty (bis in idem).

taken.rationale: Ne bis in idem.

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 234-A, IV

source.quote: IV - de 1/3 (um terço) a 2/3 (dois terços), se o agente transmite à vítima doença sexualmente transmissível de que sabe ou deveria saber ser portador, ou se a vítima é idosa ou pessoa com deficiência.

citations.cite: CP art. 234-A, IV (redação da Lei nº 13.718/2018)

readings.description: Where the victim's mental illness or disability is what makes the crime (art. 217-A, § 1º, first limb; art. 218-B for an adult), 'pessoa com deficiência' does not also increase the penalty.
The increase applies to every disabled victim.
readings.rejection_rationale: Bis in idem where the disability is the element.

taken.rationale: A child under fourteen who is also disabled is vulnerable by age, and the increase applies.

witnesses: cp-g4a-vulneravel-testes.l4: `com Ana sem discernimento e com deficiência` (no increase) against `com Carla com deficiência` (increase)

site.anchor: Art. 234-B — Segredo de justiça

source.quote: § 3º O réu condenado passará a ser monitorado por dispositivo eletrônico.

citations.cite: CP art. 234-B, §§ 1º a 3º (incluídos pela Lei nº 15.035/2024)

readings.description: §§ 1º-2º (publicity of the conviction) reach a first-instance conviction given from 28.11.2024; § 3º (electronic monitoring), a burden on the convicted person, reaches a fact committed from that day.

citations.cite: CF art. 5º, XL; CP art. 2º (harsher law not retroactive)

readings.description: All three paragraphs are procedural and apply at once to every conviction, whatever its date or the fact's.
readings.foreclosure: Monitoring restricts liberty, and a publicity rule applied to convictions already given reaches back to acts done before the law.

taken.rationale: The line between procedural and material norms; no authority found either way (the sweep did not search it).

site.anchor: crime de corrupção de menores (art. 218)

source.quote: Art. 218. Induzir alguém menor de 14 (catorze) anos a satisfazer a lascívia de outrem:

readings.description: Where the act the child is induced to is intercourse or another libidinous act WITH the other person, that person commits art. 217-A and the inducer takes part in it (art. 29); art. 218 is the inducement to an act without that contact.
Art. 218 covers every inducement to satisfy another's lust, contact or not.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 218's penalty (6-14 years) is below art. 217-A's (10-18): reading it over contact would reward the inducer of a rape of a child.

taken.rationale: The fact supplier records whether the induced act involved contact; the rule then leaves the case to art. 217-A.

site.anchor: favorecimento da exploração sexual de vulnerável consumado (art. 218-B; art. 14, I)

source.quote: Submeter, induzir ou atrair à prostituição ou outra forma de exploração sexual alguém menor de 18 (dezoito) anos ..., facilitá-la, impedir ou dificultar que a abandone

readings.description: Arts. 218-B and 228 are consummated when the victim is in prostitution or other sexual exploitation; the conduct without that result is an attempt. Arts. 229 and 230 (keeping an establishment; profiting from another's prostitution) are habitual crimes, with no attempt.
The conduct alone consummates arts. 218-B and 228.
readings.foreclosure: 'à prostituição ou outra forma de exploração sexual' is where the conduct must lead; the encoding takes it as the result.

citations.cite: CP arts. 218-B and 228: 'prostituição ou outra forma de exploração sexual'

Any prostitution is 'exploração sexual'.

citations.cite: CP art. 228: 'prostituição ou outra forma de exploração sexual'

readings.foreclosure: 'outra forma' treats prostitution as one form, but whether an adult's voluntary prostitution is exploitation is disputed; the encoding does not decide it.

site.anchor: não há crime (art. 218-C, § 2º)

source.quote: § 2º Não há crime quando o agente pratica as condutas descritas no caput deste artigo em publicação de natureza jornalística, científica, cultural ou acadêmica com a adoção de recurso que impossibilite a identificação da vítima, ressalvada sua prévia autorização, caso seja maior de 18 (dezoito) anos.

readings.description: The publication must keep the victim unidentifiable, unless the victim, being eighteen or over, authorised it beforehand; then identification is allowed.
The publication must keep the victim unidentifiable AND, for an adult victim, have their prior authorisation.
readings.foreclosure: 'ressalvada' marks an exception to what precedes it, the non-identification, not a further requirement.

taken.rationale: The grammar of 'ressalvada'. The age is read on the date of the fact.

readings.description: Read 'menor de 18 e maior de 14': a victim who has completed fourteen and not eighteen, as arts. 218-B, § 2º, I and 230, § 1º write it.
Read as printed: 'menor de 18 ou maior de 14' — every victim.

source.quote: § 1o Se a vítima é menor de 18 (dezoito) e maior de 14 (catorze) anos ou se o crime é cometido por ascendente, ...

A fortiori, § 1º reaches a victim under fourteen.

site.anchor: Capítulo VI — Do ultraje público ao pudor

source.quote: Praticar ato obsceno em lugar público, ou aberto ou exposto ao público

readings.description: 'obsceno' is an open standard, judged by the court against the prevailing sense of decency at the time.
'obsceno' has a fixed content an encoding could compute (e.g. exposure of the genitals).
readings.rejection_rationale: The Code gives no criterion; computing one would replace the judge.

taken.rationale: PLAN § 2.4: an open standard is an input finding.

notes: Art. 234 is widely described as fallen into disuse; disuse does not repeal a penal law in Brazil, and the sweep reports no ruling on it, so it is encoded as it stands.

site.anchor: crime de induzimento a erro essencial e ocultação de impedimento (art. 236)

source.quote: Parágrafo único - A ação penal depende de queixa do contraente enganado e não pode ser intentada senão depois de transitar em julgado a sentença que, por motivo de erro ou impedimento, anule o casamento.

readings.description: No attempt: the prosecution needs a marriage annulled, and so a marriage contracted.
An attempt is possible as for any crime (art. 14, II).
readings.foreclosure: An attempt could never be prosecuted: no marriage, no annulment, no queixa.

taken.rationale: The condition of procedibility.

site.anchor: a conduta do art. 242 foi praticada

source.quote: Dar parto alheio como próprio; registrar como seu o filho de outrem; ocultar recém-nascido ou substituí-lo, suprimindo ou alterando direito inerente ao estado civil:

readings.description: The semicolons make three limbs; 'suprimindo ou alterando direito inerente ao estado civil' qualifies only concealing or substituting a newborn.
The participle qualifies every limb.
readings.foreclosure: Passing off another's childbirth, or registering another's child, already alters civil status by its nature; the semicolons close those limbs.

taken.rationale: The punctuation.

site.anchor: o agente não está isento pelo art. 249, § 1º

source.quote: § 1º - O fato de ser o agente pai ou tutor do menor ou curador do interdito não o exime de pena, se destituído ou temporariamente privado do pátrio poder, tutela, curatela ou guarda.

readings.description: A parent, guardian or curator who has not been removed from or deprived of the power, guardianship, curatorship or custody is not the agent of the crime.
§ 1º only clarifies; a parent with full power may still commit the crime against the one who holds custody by court order.

citations.cite: CP art. 249, caput: 'ao poder de quem o tem sob sua guarda em virtude de lei ou de ordem judicial'

readings.foreclosure: A parent whose custody passed to another by court order is 'temporariamente privado ... da guarda', which § 1º already covers.

site.anchor: o réu condenado passa a ser monitorado, na leitura

source.quote: § 3º O réu condenado passará a ser monitorado por dispositivo eletrônico.

citations.cite: CP art. 234-B, § 1º: 'a partir da condenação em primeira instância pelos crimes tipificados nos arts. 213, 216-B, 217-A, 218-B, 227, 228, 229 e 230'
CP art. 234-B, § 2º: 'Caso o réu seja absolvido em grau recursal'
CP art. 234-B, caput: 'Os processos em que se apuram crimes definidos neste Título'

readings.description: The réu of § 3º is the réu of §§ 1º and 2º: convicted of one of the eight crimes § 1º lists (arts. 213, 216-B, 217-A, 218-B, 227, 228, 229 and 230). Only that convict is monitored.

citations.cite: CP art. 234-B, §§ 1º-3º, enacted together by Lei nº 15.035/2024; § 2º's 'o réu' is § 1º's
CP art. 1º (legality): a burden on liberty is not extended beyond its words

readings.description: § 3º complements the caput, whose subject is the processes for 'crimes definidos neste Título': anyone convicted of any crime of Título VI is monitored, including ato obsceno (art. 233), escrito ou objeto obsceno (art. 234) and promoção de migração ilegal (art. 232-A, within 'neste Título' under F-g4a-05).

citations.cite: LC nº 95/1998, art. 11, III, c (paragraphs state the complementary aspects of the caput's rule) — cited from general knowledge, not fetched

readings.foreclosure: § 3º names no crime, and its definite article continues the two paragraphs it was enacted with, whose réu is § 1º's. The wider reading would electronically monitor a convict of ato obsceno, punishable by a fine alone. No authority was found either way (the sweep did not search this paragraph), so a court could still take it.

taken.rationale: The definite article and the common enactment of §§ 1º-3º, and the restrictive reading of a burden on liberty. Both readings are executable: `o réu condenado passa a ser monitorado, na leitura` takes the reading as an input (`Leitura do art. 234-B, § 3º`), and the exported § 3º rule fixes the one taken. That is not R4's interpretation-field shape (there is no Interpretation record and no TYPICALLY), which is why the entry says resolved-at-encode.

witnesses: cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4: `estupro de 28.11.2024 condenado` (art. 213: monitored on both readings) against `ato obsceno de 2025 condenado` (art. 233) and `migração ilegal de 2025 condenada` (art. 232-A): monitored only on qualquerCrimeDoTitulo
notes: Raised by the independent test pass (ta-g4, IT-g4-173, class E): until 2026-10-08 the § 3º rule read no crime at all, so it applied the wider reading with no fork recording it.
F-g4a-08 governs § 3º's reach in time (facts from 28.11.2024); this entry governs which convicts it reaches. The two compose: the rule reads both.

delegated_field: what the agent knew: `o agente sabia o que o registro continha` and `o agente sabia que a vítima não consentira` (art. 218-C), `o agente conhecia o conteúdo do escrito, desenho, pintura, estampa ou objeto` (art. 234 caput and p.ú., I)

site.anchor: o agente conhecia o registro (art. 218-C; art. 18, p.ú.)
provisions: CP art. 234, caput e parágrafo único

source.quote: Parágrafo único - Salvo os casos expressos em lei, ninguém pode ser punido por fato previsto como crime, senão quando o pratica dolosamente.

readings.description: Dolo covers what the record or object is. Art. 218-C needs knowledge of what the record contained and, for a scene of sex or nudity, that the person had not consented; art. 234 (caput, and p.ú., I) needs knowledge of what the object said or showed. Supplied on the case; absent, no crime (art. 20). Knowing that the law treats the object as 'obsceno' is not required: that is a question of law (art. 21), and the judge's finding on obscenity stays as it was. The agent who makes the object, or puts on the show (art. 234, caput 'fazer', p.ú., II and III), acts on what he knows and needs no separate finding.
The agent must have known the object was obscene.
readings.rejection_rationale: Whether a content counts as 'obsceno' is the open standard the court applies (F-g4a-19), a legal qualification. Not knowing it is a mistake about the law (art. 21), which does not exclude dolo. Only the factual content (what the object says or shows) is within art. 20.

readings.description: Knowledge of the content is presumed from holding, buying or selling.
readings.rejection_rationale: Dolo is an element of the crime, not an exception to it (art. 18, p.ú.). A presumption convicted the dealer holding a sealed consignment, and the person who forwarded a file he never opened (audit s-dolo-audit, 2026-10).

taken.rationale: Positive findings named after their object; art. 218-C reads them in both the consummated and the attempted form. Neither article has a culpable form, so a boolean suffices, as in F-g5-34, and `Elemento subjetivo` is not used.

witnesses: cp-g4a-vulneravel-testes.l4: `divulgar cena de estupro sem saber do conteúdo`, `vender apologia sem saber do conteúdo`, `transmitir nudez sem saber do conteúdo`, `transmitir nudez crendo que ela consentira` → no crime; `divulgar cena de estupro sem saber da falta` → crime (consent is no element of a rape scene)

cp-g4a-lenocinio-testes.l4: adquirir, ter sob sua guarda and importar without knowing the content, and p.ú., I without knowing → no crime; fazer and the shows of p.ú., II and III without a finding → crime
notes: Raised by the s-dolo-audit (2026-10-08). Art. 234-B's rules read the crime of conviction and list neither art. 218-C nor art. 234, so no 234-B test moves (F-g4a-24).

Checked and left without a separate finding: art. 234 'fazer' (the agent's own making) and p.ú., II and III (his own show or recitation); art. 218-C's verbs all take the record and are covered by the one content finding; art. 218-C § 1º (a cause of increase, applied only to a crime already made out); art. 218-C § 2º (an exclusion).
Observed and left alone: art. 234 p.ú., I and II-III do not read the judge's obscenity finding in the rule, though the field's gloss says they do. Not changed here.

site.anchor: vítima vulnerável (art. 217-A, caput e § 1º)

source.quote: § 4º-A. É absoluta a presunção de vulnerabilidade da vítima e inadmissível sua relativização. (Incluído pela Lei nº 15.353, de 2026)

readings.description: Absolute: consent, prior experience and relationship are irrelevant.
Relative for facts before § 4º-A, open to distinguishing in exceptional cases.

citations.cite: CF art. 5º, XL; CP art. 2º (non-retroactivity of the harsher § 4º-A)

readings.foreclosure: STJ Tema 918 binds the lower courts and Súmula 593 states the same; the question is pending only as a TJMG representative group. An STJ or STF answer on those appeals could revive it for facts before 8.3.2026 (currency risk, M-sweep-c-11).

taken.rationale: From 8.3.2026 the text says it (§ 4º-A); before, the STJ's repetitive thesis and súmula say the same. The rule-version split at 8.3.2026 therefore gives one answer on both sides, and no rule reads consent, experience, earlier relations or pregnancy (§ 5º), tested as invariance.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 593: "O crime de estupro de vulnerável se configura com a conjunção carnal ou prática de ato libidinoso com menor de 14 anos, sendo irrelevante eventual consentimento da vítima para a prática do ato, sua experiência sexual anterior ou existência de relacionamento amoroso com o agente." (also Tema repetitivo 918)

witnesses: cp-g4a-vulneravel-testes.l4: `Carla consentiu, em` 15.1.2026 and in June 2026 — crime on both
notes: Reserved id: opened by M-sweep-c-10 and M-sweep-c-11 (sweep-c.forks-proposed.json). The relativising reading would need a court finding that the presumption was rebutted, for facts before 8.3.2026; no such field is encoded.

site.anchor: o ato constitui crime mais grave (art. 215-A)

source.quote: Pena - reclusão, de 1 (um) a 5 (cinco) anos, se o ato não constitui crime mais grave.

readings.description: Yes, where the act is slight or superficial.

citations.cite: STJ repetitive thesis of 1.7.2022 rejects it (via TJMG)

readings.rejection_rationale: Struck by the STJ's repetitive thesis (acórdão published 1.7.2022): 'independentemente da ligeireza ou da superficialidade da conduta, não sendo possível a desclassificação para o delito de importunação sexual'.

readings.description: No: with the lust purpose present it is always art. 217-A.

citations.cite: STJ repetitive thesis, acórdão published 1.7.2022 (via TJMG)

taken.rationale: Art. 215-A's 'crime mais grave' computes art. 217-A over the same case record; a libidinous act with a person under fourteen is art. 217-A however slight, so art. 215-A never captures it.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça (recurso especial repetitivo)
settled_by.citation: "Presente o dolo específico de satisfazer à lascívia, própria ou de terceiro, a prática de ato libidinoso com menor de 14 anos configura o crime de estupro de vulnerável (art. 217-A do CP), independentemente da ligeireza ou da superficialidade da conduta, não sendo possível a desclassificação para o delito de importunação sexual (art. 215-A do CP)."

witnesses: cp-g4a-liberdade-sexual-testes.l4: `importunar Carla` (not art. 215-A; art. 217-A)
notes: Reserved id: opened by M-sweep-c-12. The theme number is not shown by the source (S-sweep-c-10).

site.anchor: a agravante do art. 61, II, f, pode concorrer com o aumento do art. 226, II (STJ, Tema 1215)

source.quote: II - de metade, se o agente é ascendente, padrasto ou madrasta, tio, irmão, cônjuge, companheiro, tutor, curador, preceptor ou empregador da vítima ou por qualquer outro título tiver autoridade sobre ela;

readings.description: Never both: that would punish one circumstance twice.
readings.rejection_rationale: Struck by STJ Tema repetitivo 1215: 'não configura bis in idem a aplicação simultânea', save where authority is the only link.

readings.description: Both apply, except where the only link is the agent's authority over the victim, when only art. 226, II applies.

taken.rationale: Art. 61 is g1b's; this module says only whether art. 226, II leaves room for it: yes where domestic relations, cohabitation or hospitality (art. 61, II, f's other grounds the shared nouns carry) are present beside the art. 226, II relation.

settled_by.citation: "Nos crimes contra a dignidade sexual, não configura bis in idem a aplicação simultânea da agravante genérica do art. 61, II, \"f\", e da majorante específica do art. 226, II, ambos do Código Penal, salvo quando presente apenas a relação de autoridade do agente sobre a vítima, hipótese na qual deve ser aplicada tão somente a causa de aumento."

witnesses: cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4: `estupro pelo pai que mora com ela` (both) against `estupro pelo tutor` (only art. 226, II)
notes: Reserved id: opened by M-sweep-c-13. Art. 61, II, f's 'violência contra a mulher na forma da lei específica' is not among the shared relations and is g1b's to weigh.

site.anchor: a ação penal do art. 225

source.quote: Art. 225. Nos crimes definidos nos Capítulos I e II deste Título, procede-se mediante ação penal pública incondicionada. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 13.718, de 2018)

citations.cite: CP art. 225 (redação da Lei nº 13.718/2018, in force 25.9.2018)

readings.description: The current text (always unconditioned) applies to earlier facts too.
readings.foreclosure: A rule that removes the victim's power to condition the prosecution is harsher for the accused and does not reach earlier facts; STJ Súmula 670 applies the 2009 wording to them.

readings.description: The 2009 wording governs earlier facts: representation required, save the cases that wording excepted; estupro with real violence proceeds unconditioned (STF Súmula 608); temporary vulnerability with recovered discernment needs representation (STJ Súmula 670).

taken.rationale: The 2009 wording governs a fact before 25.9.2018, and it is not in the source: the rule refuses by name for such a fact, pointing at Súmulas 670 STJ and 608 STF. From 25.9.2018 it answers 'ação penal pública incondicionada'.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 670: "... a ação penal é pública condicionada à representação se o fato houver sido praticado na vigência da redação conferida ao art. 225 do Código Penal pela Lei n. 12.015, de 2009."

witnesses: cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4: `a ação penal do art. 225` on 25.9.2018 (answers) and 24.9.2018 (refuses)
notes: Reserved id: opened by M-sweep-c-14. Súmula 670 settles that the 2009 wording governs earlier facts; the content of that wording is what the encoding lacks.
